title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; bump v1.19.0
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: SDK users saw subtle differences in auth refresh behavior, retry backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. This caused user confusion and made cross-language integrations brittle. This PR unifies auth token refresh semantics, standardizes retry/backoff defaults, improves streaming ergonomics (cancelation, chunked events, partial-object streaming), and bumps SDK package versions to v1.19.0 across languages.

Changes in this PR: consolidated auth middleware with token auto-refresh and more explicit hooks for custom credential providers; unified retry policy implementation and default backoff parameters; added language-idiomatic streaming helpers (async generators for Python, AsyncIterable for TypeScript, context-aware streams for Go); updated docs and changelogs; parity fixes for edge cases found in the Go/TS implementations. Includes tests and small example apps.

Checklist:
- [x] Unify auth middleware implementation and public API
- [x] Standardize retry/backoff defaults and expose configuration knobs
- [x] Improve streaming API ergonomics and document examples
- [x] Add cross-language unit/integration tests for auth and retries
- [x] Bump package versions to v1.19.0 and update changelogs
- [x] Update release notes and docs site snippets

Notes: Kept backwards-compatible surface where possible; added opt-in flags for previously implicit behavior changes. See linked Linear items for design discussion and perf validation. CI validated unit and integration tests.
